newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet silent on Porsche report.
newsitem.headline: Valmet silent on Porsche report.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Valmet Oy on Wednesday declined comment on a report in German magazine Wirtschaftswoche that it is in talks with German car maker Porsche on building at least 5,000 Porsche cars in Finland.
"Our policy is not to give any kind of comment on this type of things," a Valmet spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.
According to the magazine the negotiations concern Porsche's Boxster model.
Valmet's Automotive unit is currently manufacturing Saab's 900 Cabriolet model, Opel's Calibra and Russian Euro-Samara cars at its Uusikaupunki plant in south-western Finland.
